name: mask_of_immolation_etb_one_1_1_elemental
notes: Printed: 'When this Equipment enters, create a 1/1 red Elemental creature token, then attach this Equipment to it.' After the Mask enters there is exactly one Elemental token, a 1/1 (the Mask gives no P/T). Its twin (expecting the Mask unattached) fails with the token's handle as the host, so the Mask went onto the token.
